title: The MCE codec stops allocating per attribute and per qualified name; its namespace emission is frozen as a design
decision: retained, partially implemented; the namespace-emission rewrite is designed, measured and withdrawn
reason_codes: the implemented subset is byte-identical: 6,964 real fixture parts and 30,000 mutants produce the same processed bytes, the same Report counters, the same borrow-versus-own decision and the same refusal identities, so no contract moves

the namespace-emission rewrite the survey asked for changes output bytes and was withdrawn: two writers publish the codec's processed stream (litchi-pptx guides rewrite_source, litchi-xlsb drawing_transfer), and litchi-docx depends on a property of the current emission that the rewrite removes

that property is namespace self-containment of every element span: litchi-docx slices inner w:p and w:tbl byte ranges out of the processed buffer and parses them standalone, so removing the redundant declarations breaks every Paragraph::extensions and Row::extension_ids read on a real Word document

the withdrawn design is retained as a patch with its measurements because it is worth a further 79.9% of the codec's remaining instructions, and because the blocking dependency is now written down as a test rather than left implicit
the MCE output-limit defect 0587 named is unchanged by this record and is reported as still open

the self-containment the slicing consumers rely on is already conditional: the codec borrows the input unchanged when the part carries no MCE namespace, and at the base revision litchi-docx Paragraph::extensions() already refuses on the one test-data .docx whose document.xml has no MCE namespace, with the identical error the withdrawn rewrite produces everywhere; the rewrite universalizes a pre-existing defect rather than creating one

accepted_evidence.byte_identity: mce_oracle.py raw mode over 320 fixtures and 6,964 XML/rels parts: 0 mismatches; mce_mutate.py raw mode over 30,000 mutants with 16,661 refusals: 0 mismatches
accepted_evidence.namespace_identity: mce_oracle.py canon mode over the same 6,964 parts: 0 mismatches; a positive control (before against before) is 0 and a sensitivity check (real against marker-stripped control) differs
accepted_evidence.counts: callgrind isolation pairs for the codec (6 reps against 1, differenced and divided by 5) and whole-process single runs for the public eager and source-backed reads, on one real producer worksheet and its marker-stripped control
accepted_evidence.timing: 80 samples per leg in two ABBA blocks, five warmups per block, pinned to CPU 8, with an A/A block in the same window; p50, mean, p95 and p99 per leg and paired deltas in both directions
accepted_evidence.no_regression: litchi-perf-baseline ABBA over xlsx_open_owned, xlsx_first_cell, xlsx_full_cell_scan and xlsx_narrow_column_range_scan with an A/A block: every selector moves less than the floor
accepted_evidence.unit_tests: six tests pinning the self-containment contract, the borrowed resolver's refusal identities, the pre-existing ProcessContent prefix refusal and the exact output bound
accepted_evidence.gates: fmt, clippy (workspace lints deny), test and doc for litchi-ooxml-common, plus 246 test binaries and 5,402 tests across the eight OOXML consumer crates
accepted_evidence.consumer_inventory: workspace sweep of the five codec entry points outside iWork and ODF: 133 production call sites in 7 crates (xlsx 52, pptx 39, docx 28, drawingml 7, ooxml-common 3, xlsb 2, spreadsheet-drawing 2), sorted into one hard, a partial and a publish tier; the hard case and the xlsb counter-case verified directly, five xlsx publish rows and the docx extract_sections row spot-checked, about half the xlsx and pptx sites cleared by grep rather than a full read
accepted_evidence.preexisting_defect_probe: design/docxprobe built against the untouched base checkout: 61 of 62 .docx fixtures carry the MCE namespace in word/document.xml, and on the one that does not, Paragraph::extensions() already returns InvalidFormat("Word extension XML must have one [112] root")

accepted_costs.single_fixture: the instruction and timing improvements are measured on one 209,931-byte real worksheet and its control; 0587 counted 41 of 60 XLSX fixtures as marker-bearing but no corpus-wide distribution of the improvement was taken
accepted_costs.harness_blind_spot: the generated harness corpora carry no MCE markers (0587 section 4), so the four selectors measure only that the borrowed fast path did not regress
accepted_costs.whole_process_counts: the eager and source-backed figures are whole-process single runs including process setup, not isolation pairs
accepted_costs.shared_host: seven other measurement agents were active; the A/A floor was measured in the same window and is p50 -0.92% to +0.88%, p99 +0.38% to +3.26%
accepted_costs.instruction_counts: instructions rank work, not latency; callgrind counts rep movsb per byte

known_gaps.not_measured: allocation counts, cycles, RSS, cold cache, physical I/O, throughput, concurrency scaling, cross-platform, and any DOCX or PPTX public read
known_gaps.not_fixed: litchi-docx Paragraph::extensions() already refuses on a marker-free word/document.xml at the base revision and is reported rather than fixed, because it belongs to litchi-docx; the MCE output limit is still enforced against the self-expanded stream; an element unwrapped by mc:ProcessContent still cannot declare a prefixed namespace (pre-existing, now pinned by a test); the two publication paths still publish processed bytes
known_gaps.blocked_on: landing the namespace emission needs the pre-existing litchi-docx defect fixed first (it must be fixed anyway), the partial- and publish-tier slicing consumers taught to re-inject their declarations the way the five already-hardened sites do, and a decision on whether litchi-pptx's guides edit and litchi-xlsb's anchor transfer should publish processed bytes at all

withheld: any speedup claim beyond the stated scenario, corpus, machine, build and metric
any corpus-wide, cold-cache, allocation, RSS, DOCX, PPTX or cross-platform result
any claim that the MCE output-limit defect is reduced by this change
pre_existing_failures: crates/litchi-iwa/examples/create_keynote_donut_chart.rs:68 does not compile at the base commit, blocking cargo test --workspace; reproduced on the untouched before checkout; iWork is outside this program's scope

provenance.host: AMD EPYC 9R45, 32 cores, 123 GiB, Linux 7.0.0-1012-aws, rustc 1.95.0, valgrind 3.26.0
